records.statement: A modifier on a rate stat whose base is 0 must use the flat channel; percent on zero base is a dead value. finalDamageReductionPercent is signed (min -1) so designed damage-taken downsides land. hpBelow/hpNotBelow passive conditions partition disjointly at the threshold.
validStates: flat modifiers on zero-base stats; signed clamps admit -1 floor
forbiddenStates: percent modifier on a stat whose base+flat is always 0
records.failureBehavior: clampStatValue clamps to min/max; -2 -> -1 for finalDamageReductionPercent
records.inverseBehavior: hpNotBelow active iff ratio >= percent; hpBelow iff ratio < percent
oracles: TalentsV4Wiring.test.ts asserts flat<0 + hpNotBelow condition; StatCalculator pool math

records.statement: Remote reconcile orders by save_revision first (shared clock-free sequence) with updated_at only as same-revision tie-break. Pushes are CAS PATCH guarded on the just-read revision; a lost race returns 'unavailable' without regressing local data. Push revision never goes below remote+1. updated_at is server-owned via DB trigger.
validStates: remote revision strictly advances on push
forbiddenStates: older-revision remote row resurrects via client clock skew; push overwrites a newer remote revision
postconditions: local revision adopts remote+1 lineage after successful push
legalTransitions: pull when remote ahead; push when local ahead; same-rev -> timestamp tie-break
records.atomicity: single PATCH statement is the CAS
records.persistence: localStorage revision key adopts pushed revision
uiConsequences: conflict -> unavailable surfaces a retry, not silent loss
oracles: SupabaseRemoteSave.test.ts: CAS PATCH shape, zero-row conflict, revision-adopt, clock-skew pull
